# nd_tenant_domain (Data Source)

Datasource of the tenant domain for Nexus Dashboard

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_tenant_domain" "test_resource_tenant_domain_1" {
  name = "tenant_domain1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name that uniquely identifies the tenant domain datasource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the tenant domain.
- `tenant_names` (Set of String) The complete list of tenants associated with the tenant domain.
